name: update
description: Is a newer Vyre out: one daily look at the releases, one answer every surface draws its Update card from.

settings.label: Update automatically
settings.help: Off by default. When on, Vyre installs a new release by itself between 2 and 5 in the morning, this server's time: only one signed by Vyre's release key, and it puts the old version back if the new one does not start.
